data.name: Flaming Vengeance
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day as a standard action, you can gain the benefits of a mislead spell as though cast by a wizard of level %1, with the following modifications. At the time of using this ability, you can establish a number of rounds before it will expire, or declare that it will expire when your illusory duplicate is touched. When either criteria is accomplished, the illusory duplicate explodes as a fireball spell cast by a 10th-level wizard.|min(20,TL)
